entities.name: user
entities.summary: Began as Junior Data Analyst at Bridgemark Solutions on January 15th, working in the downtown Portland office on SW 5th Avenue. The firm has approximately 200 employees. In February, the title hierarchy was restructured, and the user's title was changed to Data Analyst. Around late February, the user was moved from the general analytics pool to a dedicated client project for MedVantage, a healthcare company. On March 3rd, Diane Kowalski, the analytics team manager, assigned the user ownership of the quarterly reporting deliverable for MedVantage. The user prefers working independently and has been with the company for roughly seven months.
